code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # The marked pattern is mirrored into the zero-filled rectangle.
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg, 0)]
    if not coords:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in coords), max(r for r, c in coords)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in coords), max(c for r, c in coords)
    h, w = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    zeros = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return out
    tr0, tr1 = min(r for r,c in zeros), max(r for r,c in zeros)
    tc0, tc1 = min(c for r,c in zeros), max(c for r,c in zeros)
    base = next((grid[r][c] for r,c in coords if grid[r][c] != 1), None)
    # Main pattern is the non-background shape; mirror its color markings.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[r0+r][c0+c]
            out[tr0+r][tc0+c] = (v if v == 1 else 1)
            if v not in (bg, 1):
                out[tr0+r][tc0+w-1-c] = v
    return out
'''
